err_staff_not_found: That staff member was not found.
err_ticket_note_staff_only: Internal notes are for staff only.
err_ticket_limit: Too many open tickets; close one first.
archive_plan_body: “{title}” stops selling. Existing services are not touched.
backup_contents_hint: Each file holds the whole database and the MASTER_KEY, locked with the backup passphrase, so a fresh server gets panel and gateway passwords back too. The .env file is not included.
backup_no_passphrase: BACKUP_PASSPHRASE is not set on the server, so no backup can be written.
backup_schedule_telegram: Each one is also sent to the owner or the backups channel in Telegram.
backup_summary_off: Automatic backups are off; a backup is made only with “Back up now”.
backup_summary_hours: An encrypted backup is written every {hours} hours and the last {keep} are kept.
backup_summary_daily: An encrypted backup is written every day at {hour}:00 and the last {keep} are kept.
backup_summary_days: An encrypted backup is written every {days} days at {hour}:00 and the last {keep} are kept.
setting_backup_send_telegram_hint: To the Backups channel under Channels, or to the owner when none is set.
backup_started: Backup started. It shows up here in a few seconds.
broadcast_confirm_body: Goes to up to {n} people. Once started it can only be stopped.
bulk_runs_in_background: Runs in the background and retries when a panel does not answer. Follow it in the job queue.
bulk_scope_filter: Applies to every service the current filter finds.
cert_compare_hint: Compare this with the certificate on your server before trusting it.
deactivate_hint: Turning off signs them out everywhere.
delete_service_body: “{name}” is also removed from the panel. This cannot be undone.
duplicate_warning: This receipt matches payment #{id}. Check before approving.
err_already_set_up: The shop is already set up.
err_backup_passphrase_missing: BACKUP_PASSPHRASE is not set on the server.
err_backup_every_whole_days: Past one day, only whole days (2, 3 or 7) are possible.
err_backup_root_only: The backup schedule is set from the main shop only.
err_backup_settings_elsewhere: The backup schedule is set on the Backups page.
err_account_extras_invalid: The least and most per order must be positive, the least no more than the most (up to 100,000 GB and 3,650 days).
err_gift_empty: Enter days or GB to gift.
err_account_plan_other_panel: That plan is on another panel.
err_account_users_invalid: That user cap is not valid.
err_bad_button: Buttons need text and an https link.
err_bad_origin: Request came from an unknown origin.
err_bad_range: The date range is not valid.
err_bonus_rules_invalid: The bonus rules are not valid.
err_cannot_change_own_role: You cannot change your own role.
err_card_number_invalid: A card number or IBAN is not valid.
err_bot_not_admin: The bot is not an admin there; promote it in the channel and try again.
err_bot_stopped: This shop's bot is stopped; start it again and retry.
err_channel_not_found: Channel not found. Check the id/@name and make sure the bot is a member.
err_kinds_required: Pick at least one report kind.
err_link_required: This channel has no public username; enter an invite link.
err_internal_error: Server error. The reference is in the logs.
err_invalid_token: The setup code is wrong or expired.
err_network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.
err_not_manual: This is not a manual payment.
err_not_pasarguard: This is not a PasarGuard panel.
err_panel_error: The panel did not answer or returned an error.
err_panel_cannot_extend: This panel keeps its own limits, so time or data can't be added from here. Change it on the panel.
err_panel_cannot_revoke: This panel can't issue new credentials from here. Change the password on the panel.
err_password_or_telegram_required: A password or Telegram ID is required.
err_plan_needs_panel_or_location: Pick a panel or a location for the plan.
err_private_address_needs_owner: Only the owner can allow private addresses.
err_range_too_long: The range can be at most a year.
err_secrets_need_owner: Only the owner can change secrets or the panel address.
err_session_revoked: You were signed out. Sign in again.
err_ton_address_invalid: That TON address is not valid.
err_too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
err_tron_address_invalid: That TRON address is not valid.
err_undeliverable: Not delivered; the person blocked the bot.
forced_channels_hint: People must join these channels to use the bot. The bot must be an admin there.
channel_is_active_hint: A paused channel is not checked and gets no reports.
bot_admin_no: The bot is not an admin
invite_link_hint: For a channel without a public username, put its invite link here (e.g. https://t.me/+abc).
trust_channels_hint: Masked purchase, renewal, free-trial and top-up reports go to these channels. Choose which reports each channel gets; the bot must be an admin there.
gift_code_hint: At least 4 characters. Customers enter it in the wallet.
gift_hint: Added free of charge, for example after an outage.
gift_new_only: Only for people who have not bought yet
give_service_hint: Creates a service on that plan without charging the wallet.
inbox_empty_hint: New receipts, tickets and failed orders show up here.
inbox_keys: Keys: J and K move, A approves, R rejects, D dismisses
log_channels_hint: Each kind of report can go to its own group or topic.
login_intro: Use the username and password the shop owner set up for you.
appearance_off: The Mini App is off; customers do not see its button.
setting_miniapp_enabled_hint: The bot shows the button that opens the Mini App.
no_access: Your role cannot open this page.
no_access_hint: Ask the shop owner if you need it.
no_groups_hint: Create a group with a discount before approving resellers.
no_panels_hint: Connect PasarGuard, Marzban or 3x-ui to start selling.
no_plans_hint: Add a panel first, then create a plan.
no_resellers_hint: Requests arrive from the bot's reseller menu.
own_role_fixed: You cannot change your own role.
panel_active_hint: When off, no new services are created here.
panel_api_token_hint: When 3x-ui has an API token, it is used instead of the password.
panel_capacity_hint: Most services on this panel; empty means no limit.
panel_trial_quota_hint: Most trials this panel gives in any 24 hours (across every shop and reseller selling on it). Once full, the next trial goes to the next panel that allows trials. Empty means no cap of its own.
panel_group_ids_hint: Group numbers from PasarGuard's Groups page, comma separated (e.g. 1, 2). Left empty, users go into every group this admin may use. Save afterwards.
panel_inbound_hint: New users are created in this inbound.
panel_options_hint: New users get this selection. Save after choosing.
panel_private_hint: Only when the panel is on this server or a private network.
panel_url_hint: The address you open in a browser to sign in.
password_change_signs_out: Changing it signs you out everywhere else.
plan_description_hint: Shown to customers before they buy.
plan_panel_hint: Without a panel, the service goes to the least loaded panel in the location.
refund_body: Order #{id}'s amount returns to the wallet. The service is not changed.
reseller_permissions: What they can do in the web panel
reseller_permissions_hint: Always limited to their own customers and services.
role_admin_hint: Everything except secrets, refunds and staff.
role_owner_hint: Everything, including panel credentials and staff.
role_reseller_hint: Only their own customers and services.
search_services: Service name, panel username or subscription link
secret_set_hint: Set. Type a new value to replace it.
secret_unchanged_hint: Leave empty to keep the current one.
secrets_owner_only: Only the owner can change this.
setting_bot_enabled_hint: When off, only staff can use the bot.
setting_card_accounts_hint: One of these is shown to each customer.
setting_card_auto_approve_hint: Small receipts from customers with a clean history are approved without review; duplicates never are.
setting_crypto_enabled_hint: Customers send straight to your wallet and transfers are recognised automatically.
setting_fx_source_hint: Nobitex refreshes every 5 minutes; the manual rate is used when it is unavailable.
setting_receipt_duplicate_block_hint: When off, duplicates are only flagged.
setting_referral_percent_hint: Of the referred person's first purchase.
setting_renew_resets_usage_hint: When off, leftover data carries over.
setting_require_phone_hint: People share their number before using the bot.
setting_terms_version_hint: Raising it asks everyone to accept again.
setting_typed_confirm_enabled_hint: Deleting a service, a bulk delete or disable, and a large refund need a typed confirmation. Turn it on after the panel shows the confirm dialog.
setting_typed_confirm_refund_min_hint: Refunds of this amount or more need the amount typed. Empty: never.
err_confirmation_required: Confirm this action first: type the requested text in the dialog.
setting_topup_bonus_rules_hint: A share of each top-up added as a gift. The largest matching bonus applies.
setting_trial_generation_hint: Raising it lets everyone take a trial again.
setting_trial_panel_id_hint: Panel number; empty uses the first active panel.
setting_tron_address_hint: For USDT and TRX; starts with T.
setting_trongrid_api_key_hint: Optional; from trongrid.io for higher limits.
settlement_hint: When a payment method's money reaches your bank, record it here so its outstanding amount stays right.
setup_intro: This page appears once. It creates the owner account.
setup_telegram_id_hint: Optional; gives you the admin menu inside the bot.
setup_token_hint: Run paurubot setup-token on the server and paste the code here.
staff_note_empty: No note. Tap to write one.
staff_telegram_hint: With this ID they also get the admin menu in the bot.
sticky_code_hint: Also applies to later renewals of the same service.
title: Title
tls_hint: For a self-signed panel, check and trust its certificate once. The connection stays encrypted and verified.
webhook_hint: With a webhook, user changes reach the bot at once instead of on the next sync.
webhook_shown_once: This secret is shown once. Put it in the panel's settings now.
plan_on_hold_hint: The service's days start when the customer first connects, not at purchase.
plan_username_prefix_hint: When set, replaces the panel's prefix for usernames of this plan's services.
plan_sell_extras: Sell extra data and time for this plan's services
plan_extra_default_hint: Empty uses the default price from settings.
plan_panel_options_hint: Leave empty to use the panel's own settings.
plan_options_unreachable: The panel can't be reached; its own settings apply for now.
plan_flow_hint: For example xtls-rprx-vision; empty uses the panel's value.
app_links_default: Empty, so the default buttons (Hiddify, v2rayNG, Streisand, Happ) are shown.
setting_renew_queue_when_active_hint: Renewing a service that still has time and data applies when the current period ends.
setting_ban_disables_services_hint: Banning a customer turns their services off; unbanning turns them back on.
setting_branded_sub_links_hint: Customers see a /s/... link on the bot's domain and the panel address stays hidden.
setting_app_links: App buttons on the subscription page
setting_app_links_hint: {url} becomes the subscription link and {title} the shop name.
setting_custom_panel_id_hint: Or pick a location to use its least-loaded panel.
err_app_links_invalid: Each app needs a name and a URL like hiddify://…
err_custom_min_gb_invalid: Minimum data must be at least 1.
err_custom_max_gb_invalid: Maximum data can't be below the minimum.
err_custom_min_days_invalid: Minimum days must be at least 1.
err_custom_max_days_invalid: Maximum days can't be below the minimum.
parent_reseller_hint: Makes this a level-2 reseller: the parent sees its sales and earns the margin.
parent_discount_cap: The discount can't exceed {percent}% (the parent's discount).
billing_mode_prepaid_hint: Each purchase is charged to the wallet right away.
billing_mode_usage_hint: Services are created free; every hour the data used is charged to the wallet.
billing_mode_hourly_hint: Services are created free; every hour each active service is charged to the wallet.
credit_limit_hint: When debt goes above this, the reseller is suspended automatically.
low_balance_threshold_hint: Below this balance the reseller gets one warning a day.
reseller_suspended_banner: Your reseller account is suspended and your services are off. Debt: {debt} Toman. Top up your wallet and everything comes back within minutes.
ticket_sent: Your message was sent to the shop
sub_reseller_telegram_hint: This person must have started the bot already.
commission_explained: When a sub-reseller buys, the difference between their price and yours is added to your wallet.
sub_resellers_intro: Your sub-resellers buy with up to {percent}% off, and the price difference is your margin.
no_sub_resellers_hint: Add someone by their Telegram ID.
err_customer_must_start_bot: This ID hasn't started the bot yet.
err_subreseller_discount_too_high: The discount is above your own.
err_subreseller_not_allowed: Only level-1 resellers can have sub-resellers.
err_already_reseller: This person is already a reseller.
err_parent_must_be_level_one: The parent must be a level-1 reseller.
err_reseller_has_subresellers: This reseller has sub-resellers and can't become level 2.
err_gb_price_required: Enter a price per GB for usage billing.
err_hourly_price_required: Enter an hourly price for hourly billing.
import_intro: Users that exist on the panel but the bot doesn't know. Nothing changes on the panel; the bot just starts managing them.
import_match_telegram_hint: When a note or username holds a numeric Telegram ID, the service goes to that customer.
import_owner_hint: Every selected user goes to this customer or reseller.
import_owner_hint_fallback: Users without a Telegram ID go to this customer or reseller.
import_nothing: Every user on this panel is already in the bot
import_queued: Import started; the result is recorded in the audit log.
err_import_needs_owner: Turn on Telegram ID matching or choose an owner.
panel_renew_mode_hint: Overrides the shop setting for this panel's services.
panel_renew_mode_add: Added to current data, usage kept
restart_confirm: Users will be disconnected for a few seconds. Continue?
err_restart_not_supported: This panel can't be restarted remotely.
menu_editor_hint: Drag buttons around, or tap one to move it, colour it or give it an emoji. Buy and Services always stay.
menu_new_row: Drop here for a new row
button_colour_hint: Recent Telegram apps show the colour; older ones show a plain button.
button_emoji_id_hint: Works only when the bot's owner has Telegram Premium.
help_topics_hint: Shown under the Guide button; each one is a text or a link.
help_empty_hint: For example: Connecting on iPhone, or Renewing a service.
app_downloads_hint: Give each app's GitHub repository so the bot always hands out the latest release. The pattern picks which file.
app_cache_chat_hint: ID of a channel where the bot is an admin. Files under 50 MB are uploaded there once so customers can download without GitHub.
err_menu_layout_needs_buy: Buy and Services can't be hidden.
err_button_styles_invalid: One of the button colours isn't valid.
err_help_items_invalid: Each help topic needs a title and a text or an https link.
err_download_apps_invalid: Each app needs a name, a platform and a repository or link.
err_download_apps_repo_invalid: The repository must look like owner/repo.
customer_risk_hint: Medium and high: card receipts are never auto-approved. High: no free trial either.
reason_shown_to_customer: With notifications on, this reason is sent to the customer.
notify_customer_hint: A bot message with the service name and the reason.
login_code_sent: If this username has a Telegram ID on file, the bot has just sent it a code.
login_code_wrong: The code is wrong or has expired.
login_use_code: Log in with a Telegram code
api_keys_hint: For automation such as Grafana or scripts. Each key is shown once; only its hash is kept. Keys can never manage staff, panel passwords or backups.
api_key_shown_once: Copy this key now; it won't be shown again.
err_too_many_keys: You can have at most 10 active keys.
migration_intro: Give a MySQL export (.sql from phpMyAdmin or mysqldump) or the old bot's SQLite file. MirzaBot, Faoxima and WizWiz are supported. Customers, wallet balances, resellers and services are moved over; nothing changes on the panels.
migration_map_hint: For each old panel, pick the panel for the same server here. Services are read from that panel.
migration_safe_twice: Running it again is safe; balances and services are never added twice.
err_upload_missing: The file is gone; upload it again.
updates_agent_off: The server isn't listening for update requests.
updates_agent_hint: Run this once on the server (as root). After that you can update and roll back from here.
updates_waiting: Waiting for the server to start the {action}…
updates_update_hint: Leave both fields empty to install the newest release of the current channel.
updates_safety: A backup is written before every update. The bot is offline for about a minute while the new version starts. Rolling back restores the previous program but does not undo database changes.
updates_requested: Sent to the server. Progress shows here.
updates_confirm_body: The server will back up, then install {target}. The bot pauses for about a minute.
updates_rollback_body: The server will go back to {version}. Database changes made by newer versions stay.
err_agent_offline: The server isn't listening for update requests. Run pauru enable-agent on it.
err_update_pending: A request is already waiting for the server.
err_nothing_to_roll_back: There is no earlier version to go back to.
help_search: Search the help, e.g. receipt or reseller
help_no_results_hint: Try a shorter or different word.
svc_move_hint: The service keeps its remaining data, end date and branded link. A new account is made on the target panel and the old one is removed.
svc_move_queued: Move started; the customer is told when it's done.
err_move_unavailable: This service can't move to that panel (same panel, full, off or down).
setting_move_enabled_hint: A button on each active service moves it to another location with its remaining data and end date.
setting_bulk_buy_enabled_hint: A Buy several button at checkout creates many services of one plan in one payment.
setting_panel_accounts_gb_min_hint: An admin account owner cannot buy less extra traffic than this.
setting_panel_accounts_days_max_hint: Set the price per day on each admin account plan; 0 there means extra days are not sold.
plan_delivery_panel_hint: Each purchase creates a new account on a panel.
plan_delivery_stock_hint: Each purchase hands over one config you added to this plan's stock. Needs a location so it shows in the buy menu.
stock_save_first: Save the plan first, then add configs to its stock.
stock_paste_hint: One config per line. For configs that span several lines, leave a blank line between them. Duplicates are skipped.
stock_note_hint: Optional, for staff only (for example the source).
stock_delete_body: This unsold config is removed from the stock.
err_stock_plan_needs_location: A stock plan needs a location.
err_stock_sold: Sold inventory cannot be changed or deleted.
err_stock_too_many: Add at most 2000 configs at a time.
err_not_a_stock_plan: This plan doesn't sell from stock.
transfer_intro: Users of the first panel admin are given to the second. Nothing else about them changes and customers stay connected.
err_admins_unsupported: This panel didn't return its admins.
err_unknown_admin: That admin doesn't exist on the panel.
bundle_intro: Export settings, plans, discount codes, reseller groups, bot texts and channels as one file, then import it on another server. Secrets, customers, wallets and panel passwords are never included. Panels are matched by name.
bundle_nothing: Nothing to change; this shop already matches.
err_bundle_invalid: This isn't a valid setup file.
err_bundle_too_new: This setup file is from a newer version; update first.
lottery_intro: Customers join from the Lottery button in the bot, or every purchase in the period counts as a ticket. Winners are drawn at the end time; a wallet prize is paid automatically.
lottery_draw_body: Winners of {title} are picked and told right away.
lottery_prize_text_hint: Shown to customers, for example 3 months of 100 GB.
lottery_prize_amount_hint: 0 when you hand the prize over yourself.
err_lottery_dates_invalid: The draw time must be in the future.
setting_loyalty_enabled_hint: Customers who spend more get a standing discount. Resellers keep their own discount.
setting_loyalty_tiers_hint: Total spent on completed orders to reach each level, and its discount (up to 50%).
setting_wheel_enabled_hint: A Lucky wheel button in the bot gives a spin with a prize from the list below.
setting_wheel_prizes_hint: The chance of each slice is its weight against the total. Discount prizes become a one-time code valid for 7 days.
setting_lottery_enabled_hint: Shows the Lottery button in the bot. Lotteries themselves are set up on the Lotteries page.
setting_trust_channel_id_hint: ID of a public channel where the bot is an admin. Every paid purchase and renewal is posted there as a report with the buyer's id masked (for example 56943******), the plan, category, service and amount, plus a buy button. At most 20 posts go out per hour.
err_loyalty_tiers_invalid: Each level needs a name, a spend from 0 and a discount from 0 to 50%.
err_wheel_prizes_invalid: The wheel needs 2 to 12 slices with a label, and at least one with a weight above 0.
panel_api_token_hint_remnawave: Make one in Remnawave under Settings → API tokens. With a token, the username and password can stay empty.
panel_api_token_hint_rebecca: An API key from Rebecca. With a key, the username and password can stay empty.
panel_api_token_hint_guard: The API key from Guard. With a key, the username and password can stay empty.
panel_api_token_hint_hiddify: The admin UUID from the end of your Hiddify admin link. The panel address is that link without the UUID.
panel_sub_base_hint_hiddify: Your client link without a user, for example https://example.com/client-path/
funnel_hint: People who started the bot in this period, and how many of them went on to each step.
funnel_empty: Nobody started the bot in this period.
funnel_days_to_first: Half of the buyers made their first purchase within {days} days of joining.
setting_info_card_enabled_hint: A Card button on each service sends a picture with usage, days left, end date and the QR. After a purchase the card is sent instead of the bare QR.
setting_info_card_theme_hint: The colour set used for every service card.
setting_info_card_qr_hint: Turn off if customers share cards publicly and the link should stay private.
err_info_card_theme_invalid: Pick one of the listed card colours.
setting_variza_enabled_hint: In the Variza panel set the webhook to your server's public address followed by /api/pay/gw/variza. Payments are credited only from that signed webhook.
setting_abangateway_url_hint: The https address AbanGateway gave you, without /create at the end.
setting_abangateway_rial_hint: Leave on unless AbanGateway tells you its verify answer is in Toman. A wrong choice keeps payments waiting for review; it never credits too much.
setting_blupal_enabled_hint: Open invoices are checked every minute. For faster crediting set the webhook in the BluPal dashboard to your server's public address followed by /api/pay/gw/blupal.
setting_tronado_enabled_hint: Customers pay in TRX through the Tronado bot; the amount is converted at Tronado's rate. Needs the server's public address.
setting_tronado_wallet_hint: The TRC20 address Tronado pays out to. Use a different one from the wallet in the Crypto group.
setting_tronado_wage_percent: Share of Tronado's fee you pay (%)
setting_tronado_wage_percent_hint: 0 means the customer pays the whole fee, 100 means you do.
setting_cubepay_enabled_hint: Card-to-card and crypto through CubePay. Needs the server's public address.
setting_cubepay_fee_percent: CubePay fee added to the price (%)
setting_cubepay_fee_percent_hint: Added on top of what the customer pays at CubePay; the wallet gets the original amount.
setting_tonpay_enabled_hint: Disabled by default. Requires PUBLIC_URL and a Tonpay key. Only server-verified Toman payments settle; amount differences require review. Custom receipt mode is not supported.
setting_tonpay_custom_receipt_wait: Tonpay custom wait before receipt submission (seconds)
setting_atlaspay_enabled_hint: AtlasPay has no callback; open orders are checked every minute. AtlasPay's own markup is shown to the customer before paying.
err_abangateway_url_invalid: Enter the full https address AbanGateway gave you.
err_tronado_wallet_invalid: That TRON address is not valid.
payment_amount_differs: A different amount arrived at the gateway: {amount} Toman. Approve to credit that amount, or reject.
setting_ip_notice_enabled: Tell customers when a device is cut off
setting_ip_notice_enabled_hint: For plans with a device limit on 3x-ui and Rebecca panels: when a new device pushes an older one off, the customer gets a short notice (at most once an hour).
setting_menu_cleanup: Keep only the latest menu in the chat
setting_menu_cleanup_hint: When the bot sends the home menu again it deletes the previous one in that chat, so stale buttons do not pile up. Other messages (orders, payments, configs) are left alone.
setting_guest_buy_enabled: Guests can buy on the web
setting_guest_buy_enabled_hint: A public page at /buy on your server address sells plans without Telegram, paid through an online gateway. The buyer gets the link on a private page and can move it into the bot later.
setting_guest_plan_ids_hint: Leave empty to offer every ordinary plan.
panel_api_token_hint_wgdashboard: The API key from WGDashboard settings. The username and password can stay empty.
panel_api_token_hint_wgmate: The API key from WG-Mate. The username and password can stay empty.
panel_wg_configuration_hint: The configuration's name in WGDashboard, such as wg0. Customers get peers on it.
panel_wgmate_template_hint: An existing WG-Mate user whose protocols and server new customers copy.
panel_um_profile_hint: The profile customers get. Its validity and transfer limits on the router are what they buy; renewing assigns it again.
panel_ibsng_group_hint: The group new accounts join; its limits apply. Renewals and locking are done in IBSng.
err_configuration_invalid: Use letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores (up to 32).
err_template_user_invalid: That doesn't look like a WG-Mate username.
err_profile_invalid: That profile name can't be used.
err_group_invalid: That group name can't be used.
setting_business_enabled: Answer messages to my Telegram account
setting_business_enabled_hint: Add this bot to your account in Telegram Settings → Telegram Business → Chatbots. Only staff accounts are answered for.
setting_business_reply_hint: Sent at most once per person in the period below. {bot} becomes the link to this bot. Leave empty to answer keywords only.
setting_business_quiet_minutes_hint: While you're talking with someone, the bot doesn't step in.
setting_business_rules_hint: When a message contains one of the words, its answer is sent. The first matching row wins.
err_business_rules_invalid: Each row needs at least one word and an answer of up to 1000 characters.
err_business_reply_invalid: The standard reply can be up to 1000 characters.
role_merchant_hint: Runs a reseller's own bot: its customers, payments and tickets only.
my_bot_intro: Connect your own Telegram bot and it sells our plans under your name, at your prices. Each sale first takes your price ({percent}% off) from your wallet here, so keep it topped up; without enough balance the buyer is refunded automatically.
my_bot_needs_prepaid: Your account is billed by usage. An own bot needs prepaid billing; ask the shop owner to switch you.
my_bot_token_hint: Make a bot with @BotFather and paste its token. It must not be used by any other program.
my_bot_connected: Bot connected. Open it in Telegram and press Start.
my_bot_stop_body: The bot stops answering. Its customers, wallets and services stay; connect a token again to bring it back.
my_bot_markup_hint: Used for every plan without a price of its own below.
my_bot_cards_hint: Your own cards: buyers pay you, and you approve receipts in your bot.
my_bot_enabled_hint: When off, only you can use the bot.
err_bot_token_invalid: Telegram doesn't accept that token. Copy it again from @BotFather.
err_bot_token_is_main: That is the main shop's own bot.
err_bot_token_in_use: Another reseller already uses this bot.
err_reseller_bot_needs_prepaid: An own bot needs prepaid billing.
err_resale_prices_invalid: Prices must be whole Toman amounts.
err_resale_setting_unknown: That setting can't be changed here.
my_bot_blocked: The shop's staff stopped your bot. Ask them to allow it again before connecting.
err_reseller_bot_blocked: The shop's staff stopped this bot; they need to allow it first.
hidden_panels_hint: This group's resellers neither see nor buy plans on these panels.
reseller_prices_hint: Set a price per plan; empty means the percentage discount applies. A reseller's own price beats its group's.
reseller_prices_after_save: Save the group first, then set fixed prices per plan.
account_intro: Sell PasarGuard admin accounts: the buyer gets its own admin with a role, a traffic quota and a user cap, and creates its users in the panel. Turn it on under Settings → Resellers (Sell PasarGuard admin accounts).
account_needs_pasarguard_hint: Admin accounts are created on a PasarGuard panel. The bot's admin on it needs permission to manage admins.
account_role_hint: The PasarGuard role the sold admin gets; it decides what the admin may do.
account_roles_failed: The panel didn't list its roles; type the role ID from PasarGuard (Admin roles).
account_max_users_hint: Empty uses the role's own limit.
account_day_price_no_end: This plan never ends, so extra days are not sold for it.
account_change_reason_hint: Optional; sent to the owner with the change.
account_new_password_body: The account's password changes and the owner gets the new login in the bot.
account_change_plan_hint: Plans on the same panel only. Later renewals and add-ons follow the new plan.
give_account_hint: A free admin account on this plan is created for this customer, and the login is sent to them in the bot.
account_given: The account is being created; it will be ready in a few seconds.
account_renew_mode_hint: What a renewal does to the panel's time and traffic left. An ended panel always starts from today with a fresh quota.
account_audience_hint: Who sees and buys this plan. 'Admin accounts for resellers only' in Settings still applies to every plan.
account_renew_packages_hint: On renewal the buyer picks one of these packages; each has its own period, traffic and price.
account_package_columns: Days, traffic (0 means no quota) and price of each package.
account_renew_custom_hint: The buyer chooses the days and traffic within the least and most; price = days × price per extra day + GB × price per extra GB.
account_renew_plain: Neither is on: a renewal repeats the plan with the same period, traffic and price.
account_ranges_hint: For extra traffic and days and the custom renewal of this plan. Empty uses the value in the Resellers section of Settings.
account_delete_body: {username} is removed from the panel. Its users stay in the panel without an owner. Nothing is refunded.
setting_reseller_web_access_hint: On approval a reseller gets its own sign-in here (a Telegram code, no password) to sell, renew and see reports.
desk_sold: Sold. The service is being created.
desk_label_hint: Shown on the service so you can find it later.
desk_low_balance: Not enough in your wallet. Top it up in the bot.
setting_wallet_transfer_enabled: Customers can send balance to each other
setting_wallet_transfer_daily_max: Most a customer can send a day (Toman)
setting_referral_min_order: Smallest first order that earns a referral reward (Toman)
setting_referral_daily_max: Referral rewards per inviter per day
setting_referral_daily_max_hint: Stops reward farming with fake accounts; 0 means no limit.
setting_start_gift_amount_hint: Added to the wallet once, on first /start. 0 turns it off; keep it small.
setting_start_gift_referred_only: Welcome gift only for invited customers
customer_card_trust_hint: Trusted: receipts are approved at once. Blocked: card to card isn't offered.
setting_card_auto_approve_after_minutes_: 0 turns it off. Only up to the auto-approve amount; duplicates and risky customers always wait for a person.
setting_card_pick_hint: all, random (one at random) or rotate (one card after another).
setting_card_random_tail: Add a random tail to card amounts
setting_card_random_tail_hint: A few Toman (up to 999) so every receipt matches one payment; the extra goes to the customer's wallet.
setting_card_verify_enabled_hint: Before paying card to card, the customer sends the card number and a photo of the card; staff approve it in the bot. Trusted customers skip this.
plan_renew_mode_hint: What happens to the time and data left when this plan is renewed.
renew_mode_extend_reset: Add the time; data starts fresh
renew_mode_extend_carry: Add the time; leftover data carries over
renew_mode_restart_reset: Start again today; data starts fresh
renew_mode_restart_carry: Start again today; leftover data carries over
setting_renew_mode_hint: extend_reset, extend_carry, restart_reset or restart_carry; empty follows "Renewal resets usage". A plan can choose its own.
err_renew_mode_invalid: Pick one of the renewal modes.
code_customer_hint: Leave empty for a public code. The customer is told about a private code and sees it under My discounts in the bot.
setting_reseller_membership_price_hint: 0 turns it off. Customers pay from the wallet and become resellers at once, without an application.
setting_referral_monthly_max: Referral rewards per inviter per 30 days
setting_referral_reward_mode_hint: What the inviter gets: a share of the friend's purchase in the wallet, a free config for every few invites, or both.
setting_referral_config_counts_hint: “On purchase”: a friend counts with their first qualifying purchase (the same minimum as the cash reward), so fake accounts gain nothing. “On join”: as soon as they join with the link. Banned customers never count.
setting_referral_config_every_hint: One free config for every this many counted invites (1 to 1000).
setting_referral_config_source_hint: One of the shop's plans, or a size and duration on a panel.
setting_referral_config_plan_id_hint: Used when the source is “A plan”.
setting_referral_config_gb_hint: Used when the source is “Custom size and days”.
setting_referral_config_days_hint: Used when the source is “Custom size and days”.
setting_referral_config_panel_id_hint: Used when the source is “Custom size and days”: the config is made on this panel.
setting_referral_every_purchase_hint: Off: only the invited customer's first purchase pays the inviter.
setting_referral_repeat_percent_hint: Empty uses the same percent as the first purchase.
setting_self_delete_enabled: Customers can delete their own services
setting_self_delete_refund_percent_hint: What share of the unused part (time or data, whichever is less) of the last payment goes back to the wallet. 0 means no refund.
menu_mode_hint: Staff always keep the keyboard, for the admin button. Premium emoji, the start sticker and the buy banner are set in the bot: Admin → Appearance.
err_menu_mode_invalid: Pick one of the menu modes.
setting_reseller_bot_open_hint: Every prepaid reseller (not sub-resellers) can build its own sales bot from the bot or the web panel, without a separate tick.
setting_custom_username_enabled_hint: When buying in the bot, the customer types the service name or skips. If the panel already has it, a few characters are added at the end.
trial_again_done: This user can take one more trial.
err_trial_not_used: This user hasn't taken a trial yet and can take one now.
customer_hidden_panels_hint: This user can't see or buy the plans of these panels (nor in their own sales bot, for a reseller).
err_schedule_invalid: Pick a time in the future, at most 60 days ahead.
err_not_pausable: Only a queued or running broadcast can be paused.
err_no_telegram: Link your Telegram account and start the bot to receive a test.
cap_scope: This report checks this connection and the bot’s current credentials. It is not a purchase guarantee or permanent panel health certificate.
cap_forbidden: Running a report requires panel-management permission.
cap_write_title: Write probe — optional and changes the panel
cap_write_warning: This creates a temporary pbprobe_ user, reads it, changes its limit and revokes its link when supported, then attempts deletion. If cleanup fails, you must remove the temporary user manually.
cap_write_ack: I authorize creating and changing the temporary user, and accept manual cleanup if deletion fails.
cap_run_write: Run write probe with my permission
cap_running_hint: Do not submit another request until the result arrives. Closing the browser does not cancel work already started on the server.
cap_uncertain: A temporary user may have been created; its result or cleanup is unknown. Check pbprobe_ users and panel logs before repeating.
cap_no_auto_retry: No automatic retry. A new run requires a new explicit action.
cap_not_run: No checks yet. Opening this screen runs no probe.
cap_write_tested: Write probe ran. Check every step, especially temporary-user deletion.
cap_write_not_run: Write probe did not run because the initial connection failed.
cap_read_only: Read-only checks ran. User creation, modification and deletion have not been tested.
cap_cleanup: Temporary-user deletion failed. Inspect the username/details in the deletion step and remove it manually.
cap_snapshot_hint: This is a snapshot of this manual run. Changing the address, credentials or panel version can invalidate it.
err_capability_invalid: The capability response was unreadable or inconsistent.
cap_declared_hint: Some rows, including client IPs, webhooks, delivery and supported changes, are driver declarations; a passed row does not mean every operation was live-tested.
cap_cleanup_unconfirmed: Temporary-user deletion is not confirmed; creation may also have failed. Check pbprobe_ users and panel logs before repeating the probe.
typed_confirm_hint: Type the value above. Persian and Arabic digits are accepted.
typed_confirm_expired: This confirmation expired. Request a new one; the action has not been submitted.
typed_confirm_bulk_scope: Review the server-confirmed selection count below. This confirmation applies only to this selection.
void_confirm_body: This payment's credit is taken back from the customer's wallet, and the purchase it paid for is cancelled and its service turned off. This cannot be undone.
voided_toast_kept: Payment voided, but a reward or commission the receiver already spent was not taken back.
void_explain: Void a payment that was approved by mistake, such as a fake receipt. Its credit and any purchase made with it are taken back. If the customer already spent the credit elsewhere, nothing is voided.
void_block_card: Block card payments for this customer
void_block_card_hint: The customer cannot pay by card-to-card again until someone unblocks it.
void_reason_wrong_amount: The amount received did not match the receipt
void_done_order: The purchase of order #{id} was cancelled and refunded to the wallet.
void_done_service: Service #{id} is being turned off on its panel.
void_done_blocked: Card payments are blocked for this customer.
err_void_reason: The void reason is not valid.
err_void_not_voidable: Only an approved card payment, or a transfer staff approved by hand, can be voided.
err_void_not_settled: This payment's credit is still being recorded. Try again in a moment.
err_void_order_in_progress: The order of this payment is still being delivered. Try again when it is done.
err_void_order_kind: This payment paid for a renewal or change of an existing service and cannot be voided automatically. Fix the service and wallet by hand.
err_void_stock_delivered: This order delivered a ready-made config that cannot be taken back. Handle it by hand.
err_void_service_missing: The service of this order was not found. Check the order first.
err_void_service_changed: Another payment was made on this order's service later. Turning it off would also take away that purchase; handle it by hand.
err_void_order_state: The order of this payment is in a state that cannot be voided.
err_void_wallet_spent: The customer already spent this payment's credit. Cancel the other purchase or adjust the wallet by hand first.
setting_card_sms_enabled: Confirm card payments by bank SMS
setting_card_sms_enabled_hint: An SMS forwarder app on the phone that receives the account's SMS posts each message to https://<domain>/api/sms/card/<shop id> with the key in the X-Api-Key header (or a key field). A deposit SMS whose amount matches exactly one open payment approves it. While on, every card payment asks for a unique amount.
setting_card_sms_secret_hint: At least 24 random characters. Anyone holding it can approve payments; enter it only in the forwarder app.
err_card_sms_secret_short: The SMS webhook key must be at least 24 characters.
err_card_sms_secret_required: Set the SMS webhook key before turning SMS confirmation on.
setting_trial_min_account_minutes_hint: A brand-new account gets no free trial until this much time has passed. 0 turns it off. Makes accounts created only for a trial costlier.
setting_miniapp_accent_hint: Presets only, so text stays readable in light and dark. Each reseller bot has its own.
setting_miniapp_logo: Mini App logo from the bot's profile photo
setting_miniapp_logo_hint: The bot's Telegram profile photo shows beside the shop name on the Mini App home screen (cached for a few hours).
setting_miniapp_notice_hint: One short paragraph (300 characters at most) above the wallet. Empty means none.
err_miniapp_accent_invalid: That colour is not one of the presets.
err_service_busy: This service is being changed right now (a renewal, for example). Try again in a few seconds.
